newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Shell Singapore expects July output at 49,000-tpd.
newsitem.headline: Shell Singapore expects July output at 49,000-tpd.

text.p: Shell Singapore expects output at its 59,000 tonnes per day (tpd) refinery to average 49,000 tpd in July, down 1,000 tpd from an earlier forecast, a company spokesman said on Monday.
The refinery shut a 115,000 barrel-per-day (bpd) (15,500-tpd) crude distillation unit (CDU) for one week of maintenance on July 6, the spokeswoman said.
Shell on July 2 said it had cut crude runs to 50,000 tpd because of poor margins and high stocks of middle distillates.
"Taking into account the shutdown of CDU 4 for maintenance the average refinery runs for July are expected to be 49,000 tpd," the spokeswoman told Reuters.
She said the crude run cuts would be maintained "subject to market conditions."
Industry sources earlier said that Exxon Singapore has also cut crude runs by about 10 percent late last month at its 230,000 bpd refinery, but Exxon officials declined to comment.
